CHATTYVAKUUSEARRING-ALLOW_WHISPERING_WIT: Allows Vakuu's whispering system even without the Whispering Earring. Relic's effects and the dialogue resulting from them do not occur.
CHATTYVAKUUSEARRING-SPEECH_DURATION_MULT: Multiplies how long Vakuu's speech bubbles stay on screen. Increase this further if you find yourself unable to finish reading before the bubble disappears.
